title: One Bias Score, Two Factors: How Mitigations Affect Option Bias in Multiple-Choice Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.20993v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reordering multiple-choice options can change a model's answer, an effect studied as selection bias (a preference for certain option letters) and as order sensitivity (changes in answers across option orderings). We connect these perspectives through the pooled selection-rate standard deviation (pooled SD), which measures how unevenly option letters are selected across questions and orderings. When every option of each question appears equally often at each position, the pooled SD is exactly the product of two label-free factors: the flip rate and the positional skew. The flip rate is the fraction of questions whose chosen option changes across orderings; the positional skew is the standard deviation of option-letter selection rates among those questions. Across 41 checkpoints and 12 benchmarks, the flip rate tracks accuracy and output uncertainty, while the positional skew tracks the estimated option-symbol prior. Prior correction for s

translated_title: 一个偏置分数，两个因素：缓解方法如何影响多项选择题评估中的选项偏置
translated_abstract: 重新排列多项选择题的选项可以改变模型的答案，这一效应既被研究为选择偏置（模型对某些选项字母的偏好），也被研究为顺序敏感性（答案随选项排列顺序的变化）。我们通过合并选择率标准差（pooled SD）将这两种视角联系起来，该指标衡量选项字母在不同问题和排列之间被选择的不均匀程度。当每个问题的每个选项在每个位置出现的频率相同时，合并标准差恰好是两个无标签因素的乘积：翻转率和位置偏斜。翻转率是指所选选项在不同排列之间发生变化的问题比例；位置偏斜是指这些问题中选项字母选择率的标准差。在41个模型检查点和12个基准测试上，翻转率与准确率和输出不确定性相关，而位置偏斜与估计的选项符号先验相关。对先验的修正……（摘要原文截断于此）
tldr: 该论文提出用合并选择率标准差统一选择偏置与顺序敏感性两种视角，并证明该指标可精确分解为翻转率（反映模型不确定性）和位置偏斜（反映选项符号先验）两个无标签因素，从而揭示了现有缓解方法影响选项偏置的内在机制。
en_tdlr: This paper unifies selection bias and order sensitivity through the pooled selection-rate standard deviation, proving it exactly decomposes into two label-free factors—the flip rate (tracking model uncertainty) and positional skew (tracking option-symbol priors)—thereby explaining how mitigation strategies affect option bias in multiple-choice evaluation.
